description.fun: Mesprit, the Being of Emotion, is said to have taught people the joy and sorrow of living as it flew. Legend says anyone who touches it has their emotions drained away, and that it threw the feelings of those who disrespected it into disarray. Unlike Uxie and Azelf it doesn't stay home: once met at Lake Verity, it flies off to roam Sinnoh.
description.guide: Mesprit is a Psychic-type Legendary Pokémon and one of Sinnoh's three lake guardians, with Uxie and Azelf. Known as the Being of Emotion, it lives in Lake Verity and is said to have taught people sorrow, pain and joy.
description.tagline: The lake guardian that gave people joy and sorrow.
